Name: MENU_WINDOW_PARAM_ST
Description: Menu windows: open and close sounds and animation, icon, title text, line help and key guide texts, and the property layout used by shop-type menus.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: No reader found. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Opening Sound
Fields.Description: Sound played when the menu opens. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Closing Sound (Alternate)
Fields.Description: Sound played instead of Closing Sound when the window is closed with a particular close result (not the usual one; likely backing out). -1: none. Retail: usually the same ID as Closing Sound.

Fields.Name: Closing Sound
Fields.Description: Sound played when the menu closes. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Open/Close Animation
Fields.Description: 1: the window slides in and out. Other values: it fades in and out. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Save Request on Close
Fields.Description: When the window closes: 1 raises a request on the game manager (skipped if one was raised within the last minute), 2 raises a second, separately timed request as well. Likely an autosave request (not confirmed). Retail 1 on Roundtable menus that change saved data (Relic Rites, Change Garb, Shop, Level Up...), 2 on System.

Fields.Name: Unknown Window Value
Fields.Description: Returned by the window's settings query (3 when it has no row); its use is not established. Retail 0-3 (1 on most rows, 3 on 22).

Fields.Name: Close by Input
Fields.Description: 1: a specific input (likely the button that closes all menus) closes this window. Retail 1 on 31 rows (most Roundtable and in-expedition menus).

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Menu icon shown with the window. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Title Text ID
Fields.Description: Menu Text shown as the window's text. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Line Help Text ID
Fields.Description: Line Help text shown with the window. -1: none. Retail: set only on the Small Jar Bazaar rows.

Fields.Name: Menu Property Layout ID
Fields.Description: No reader found. Retail: MenuPropertyLayoutParam rows on four menus only: Small Jar Bazaar 21600, Collector Signboard 21700, Equipment 20300, Shop 20100; -1 elsewhere.

Fields.Name: Key Guide Text ID 1
Fields.Description: Key Guide text shown with the window. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Key Guide Text ID 2
Fields.Description: A second Key Guide text for the window. -1: none.
